title: 时事：AI 改变生活
description: 人工智能如何改变我们的日常生活

sentences.text: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we live and work.
sentences.translation: 人工智能正在改变我们生活和工作的方式。

sentences.text: Smartphones can now translate conversations in real time.
sentences.translation: 智能手机现在可以实时翻译对话。

sentences.text: More people are using apps to learn new languages.
sentences.translation: 越来越多人用 App 学习新语言。

sentences.text: Technology makes our lives more convenient every day.
sentences.translation: 科技让我们的生活每天都更便利。

sentences.text: The future of technology is full of exciting possibilities.
sentences.translation: 科技的未来充满了令人兴奋的可能。
